newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin rises further on weak rgt, higher LME.
newsitem.headline: KL tin rises further on weak rgt, higher LME.

text.p: Tin price ended eight cents higher at 14.23 ringgit ($5.65) a kg with sentiment still boosted by a weak Malaysian ringgit against the U.S. dollar, coupled with gains in London, traders said.

"There was also all-round buying from Europe, Japan and Malaysia," a trader said. Turnover rose to 79 tonnes from 68 on Tuesday. Traders expect more demand from overseas if London rallies further. "The Malaysian ringgit is not so strong and we expect prices to rally further if London metal rises further," said the trader. The local price premium was unchanged at Tuesday's $85. -- Tan Lee Lee (603-275-6834) ($1=2.5155 ringgit)
